items.title: Horn Shirley — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I met her once and I was really overwhelmed, recent years, you know. She was at Antoine‘s. I went to see her... I went to the hotel to see her.

ctx.x: What are your earliest recollections of hearing music in your household? And what styles . . .

I heard Billie Holiday. I heard Dinah Washington. I heard Count Basie. I heard, oh, good lord, I heard all the best; everything that was good, I heard. Duke Ellington; I mean, I was surrounded by the best. I mean, I heard all the good stuff, all the goodies.
Did both of your parents have an interest in music?
